title: Regeneration
description: An axolotl regrows a whole limb from the stump, reading a gradient to know what goes where. Unlocks Grown Organs, which mend worn gear.

puzzle.goal: A morphogen made at one end and broken down everywhere falls off as it spreads. Write its level c at distance x, from a source c0 and a decay length L.
puzzle.name: Exponential gradient
puzzle.ask: Find y for a = @{a}, x = 3 and L = @{L}.
puzzle.method: Spread balanced against breakdown gives an exponential fall, decay length sqrt(D/k): each cell reads its own place.
